hero.title: London Office
hero.photoAlt: Downstairs lobby at the London office with the Box teacup logo wall

items: Street parking is available on Mallow Street (located behind the building).
Paid parking is available at NCP London Finsbury Square.
Old Street Station: Northern Line (2 min walk)
Liverpool Street Station: Elizabeth Line, Overground, Central, Circle, Hammersmith & City, Metropolitan and National Rail Services (10–15 min walk)
Liverpool Street also services lines to Heathrow Airport and Stansted Airport

paragraphs.html: When you arrive, please sign in at the reception desk on the ground floor of the White Collar Factory and state that you are visiting Box. You will be sent up to the 15th Floor where Box's reception is located.
Once on the 15th floor, the Box receptionist will ask you to sign in at Box and complete a visitor non-disclosure agreement, if you haven't already done so.

cards.title: Photo ID
cards.body: Please bring a valid government ID (license, passport, or other government-issued ID) to verify your identity at check-in.

cards.title: NDA
cards.body: Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the link provided by your Recruiting Coordinator.

cards.title: Arrival & departure
cards.body: After your last interview, your interviewer will walk you to the elevator.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
